record.question: What is the antonym of ephemeral?
record.explanation: Ephemeral means lasting a very short time. Perennial can mean persistent or enduring, so it is the supplied antonym. Fleeting and transient are near synonyms of ephemeral; succinct concerns brevity of expression. Verified solution (unofficial); reviewed 26 October 2026. References: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/ephemeral; https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/perennial
